have h_kmp : 71 ≤ h 3 4 := by
  exact erdos_934.variants.kmp_h_three_four
have h_inj : h 3 4 + 4 ^ 2 ≤ 4 ^ 3 + 4 + 2 := by
  specialize H 4
  exact H
have h_num : 87 ≤ 70 := by
  calc
    87 = 71 + 16 := by norm_num
    _ ≤ (h 3 4) + 16 := by
      have : 71 + 16 ≤ (h 3 4) + 16 := by
        exact Nat.add_le_add_right h_kmp 16
      exact this
    _ = (h 3 4) + 4 ^ 2 := by norm_num
